personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT typography and warmth
personality_one_liner: A premium, appetizing, and fast Italian ordering experience balancing elegant editorial warmth with high-performance utility.

spacing.rule: iOS-native comfortable vertical spacing. Generous padding around content. Empty space should feel like deliberate breathing room, not a broken layout.

do's: Sticky CTA container at the bottom of the pizza customizer and checkout
dont's: Dense data tables in the staff dashboard

screens.name: Customer Menu (Home)
screens.purpose: Showcase the menu categories and appetizing items for quick ordering.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for pizza cards, centered spinner for categories.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty plate, 'Menu is loading...'
states.error: Error message with 'Retry' button to fetch the menu.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image of a wood-fired pizza with gradient scrim (top to bottom, to 70% surfaceInverse) and the title 'Hallo Magic Pizza'. Below: horizontally scrolling category chips (Pizzas, Pâtes, etc.). Below: vertical list of menu items. Each item uses a clean layout: high-quality image on the left or top, title in Playfair Display, description, and CHF price.

screens.name: Product Detail (Customization)
screens.purpose: Allow the customer to customize their pizza with removals, extras, and notes.

states.loading: Spinner over the image, skeletons for options.

screens.layout: Large hero photo of the item, gradient scrim. Scrollable content: 'Remove Ingredients' as wrapping chips (brandTertiary), 'Add Extras' as a list with prices and +/-, and a 'Kitchen Note' text input. Fixed bottom container (glass or solid surface) with the live total price and a large primary CTA button to 'Add to Cart'.

screens.name: Checkout
screens.purpose: Finalize the order details for pickup or delivery without online payment.

states.empty: Cart is empty with a 'Browse Menu' CTA.

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (Pickup vs Delivery). Form inputs for guest info (Name, Phone, Address if delivery). Order summary list. Fixed bottom CTA to 'Confirm Order (Pay at Pickup)'.

screens.name: Order Tracker
screens.purpose: Visual timeline of the customer's active order status.
screens.layout: Large circular estimated time display prominently at the top. Below: vertical timeline (Confirmed, Preparing, Baking, Ready/Delivering). Active step highlighted in brandPrimary.

screens.name: Staff Dashboard (Tablet)
screens.purpose: Unified management for incoming orders and quick decision-making.
screens.layout: Two-column tablet layout. Left panel (30%): Scrollable queue of incoming order cards. Right panel (70%): Details of the selected order with oversized 'ACCEPTER' (success) and 'REFUSER' (error) buttons. Quick-select time chips (15, 20, 30, 40, 45, 60 min) and delay buttons (+5, +10) next to the accept button.

screens.name: Kitchen Dashboard (KDS)
screens.purpose: Clear, high-visibility grid of active orders for the kitchen staff.
screens.layout: Masonry or multi-column grid of active orders. Huge typography for items and customizations (extras in brandSecondary, removals in error color). Entire card is a large tap target to mark as 'Done'.

screens.name: Ticket Preview
screens.purpose: Simulate an 80mm thermal receipt for printing.
screens.layout: Brutalist layout. Off-white background, mono typography (Courier or Space Mono), centered text, dashed lines for separators. High contrast for readability.

hero_pasta.alt: Fresh Italian pasta with cherry tomatoes

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement bilingual support (French default, German) for the customer app.
Both customer and staff workflows exist in the same app; provide a clear entry routing point or dev toggle to switch between Customer Mode and Staff Mode.
Customer Menu: Implement horizontal scroll for categories and a vertical scroll for items.
Pizza Customizer: Must support removing standard ingredients and adding extras with LIVE price updates reflected in the sticky bottom CTA.
Checkout: No online payment. Implement segmented control for Pickup vs Delivery, and capture guest info.
Staff Dashboard: MUST use a responsive 2-column layout for tablets. The right pane needs massive 'ACCEPTER/REFUSER' buttons and quick-time pickers.
Kitchen Dashboard: Maximize legibility with large text. Show added extras prominently and highlight removed ingredients (e.g., strike-through or red text).
Ticket Preview: Use a Monospace font to simulate an 80mm thermal printer output.
Any image with text on it (like the Home Hero or Product Detail Hero) MUST use a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to 70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text contrast.
